name: web-watch-strap-shop-with-lime-outlined-headline-and-lime-testimonial
title: Watch-strap store in white, grey and electric lime: outlined keyword headline, product card, best-seller grid and a lime quote block
whatItIs: Three views: a desktop page with a lowercase headline 'legacy steel black sport pro strap' where words are wrapped in lime outlined pills, a price and lime add-to-cart, a large product card with a black watch and colour and size selectors, a 'shop by' tab row, a three-product grid with stars, and a 'why milanese loop?' section with a lime testimonial card; a long mobile version and a second mobile screen with text and lime quote block.
whatItMeans: Clean and fresh; lime accents on a quiet white grid give a tech-accessory feel.
techniques: Wrap headline words in thin lime outlines.
Use one lime for buttons and quote block.
Round product tiles in light grey.

vocabulary.definition: A word inside a thin coloured outline.
A bright green card holding a testimonial.
A capsule for size or colour choice.
